message:
We all have that one friend who seems to panic at the slightest sign of trouble. I remember a time when a simple thunderstorm sent her into a frenzy, racing around her house, gathering snacks and blankets like a storm was about to hit. It made me chuckle, but it also got me thinking about how being prepared doesn’t mean we have to stress out. 

Instead, we can take a deep breath, pack a go-bag, and make a family plan while enjoying each other’s company. Being ready can be a calm, shared experience, rather than a chaotic scramble. After all, it’s not about fearing the storm, but ensuring we’re ready for whatever comes our way. 😊
